main_text.p: cipiebant, cùm sacrificium holocaufti & libamen oblatum erat; rationes habes in Erachin in Gem. fol.11. & Gloff.in Pefachin c.5. f.64.

§. Psalmi quos ordinariè cantabant sequentes erant. Die primo septimanæ Psal.xxiv. Die secundo xlviii. Psalm. Die tertio Psal.82. Die quarto94 Psalm. Die quintoPsal.81. 'Die sexto Psalm.93. Die sabbathi verò Psalm.92. Tamid ubi supra. Rationes cur hos elegerint Psalmos vid. in Rosch Hafchana fol.31. Maym. in Tamid. cap.6. Vnumquemque ex his Psalmis in tres partes Cantores dividebant, in quibus paufas faciebant, quas Talmudici פרקים nominant, in his paufis tubis canebant, & populus adorabat, secundùm illud על כל פרק תקיעה ועל כל תקיעה השתחויה In unaquaque Paufa erat taratantara tuba, & apud unamquamque taratantaram adoratio populi. Vid. Tamid. c.7. & Rosch Hafchana loc. mod. cit.
§. Extraordinarios clanctus tubarum edebant in vefpera Sabbathi ad populum à labore revocandum, & ad distinguendum diem insequentem à diebus profestis. Succah. c.5.

§. In ipso Sabbatho tempore sacrificii additionalis de quo Num.28.9.10. Levitæ cantabant canticum Mosis (Deut. 32.) Maymon in Tamid. cap. 6. & Sacerdotes tubis suis tribus aliis vicibus, quàm in ordinariâ Musicâ solebant, clangebant. Succah ubi supra.
§. Ad Sacrificia additionalia primi diei anni (Num.29.1.2.) Levitæ cantabant Psal.81. & tubis etiam clangebant ad indicandum annum novum. Vesperâ verò huius diei cantabant

page.notes: Page is one text column; the printed marginal marks are faint and no legible margin notes were identified. Hebrew words in the text (פרקים, על כל פרק תקיעה ועל כל תקיעה, השתחויה) are transcribed as printed, though some are doubtful. Some words are blurred, e.g. "Rosch" and "Fabbathi".
